name: Comparative Public Law and Systems of Governance
seo_title: UGC NET Law Comparative Public Law Notes (Unit 10)
description: UGC NET Law Comparative Public Law notes: 12 topics, 63 sub-topics on federalism, rule of law, constitutional review and the Ombudsman. Free, with revision mode.
intro: Unit X is a comparison unit, and examiners love contrasts: India versus the USA, the UK versus the USA, Switzerland versus France. The ten topics cover comparative method, forms of government, federalism, rule of law, separation of powers, the judiciary, constitutional review, amendment, the Ombudsman and open government. Each topic ends with a Memory Capsule of exam traps, and Topic 11 collects question patterns, a one-page cheat sheet of names and numbers, common mistakes and a revision plan.
how: Start with Topic 0 for the four kinds of questions, then read Topics 1 to 10 in order. Build a mental table for each topic: definition, thinkers, cases and the country-wise comparison.
Switch on Revision mode on any topic page to keep each section's tables and lists, plus the Memory Capsule of exam traps. Write the comparison tables (India, USA, UK, France) from memory.
Use the rapid-recall sheet (names and numbers by topic), then Topic 11 and practice MCQs.
